status: 문헌·공식 calibration 코드·C4 pinned source prefix 확인 및 설계 갱신. 정식 reference768·token·teacher·GPU 실험 미생성.

corpus.variant: official cleaned English C4, not en.noclean / en.noblocklist / multilingual default
corpus.verification_scope: HTTP206 first 1MiB per pinned file; decompressed complete rows and source schema
corpus.loader: pinned .json.gz files -> gzip JSONL; old load_dataset script/config aliases need not be copied

secondary_comparator.name: The Pile
secondary_comparator.next_requirement: backup text/schema/source-composition/duplicate audit and independent split contract before Pile runs
secondary_comparator.role: 후속 두 번째 corpus 대조; 첫 C4 실험 선행조건 아님

corpus.native_mom2_projector_dataset: existing wikipedia assets, unchanged by this reference contract

sampling.scan_scope: each complete pinned first shard; do not sample only a decompressed prefix
sampling.within_shard_rule: 전체 shard의 유효 JSONL row 중 hash priority가 가장 작은 후보를 보관; 내용·길이·중복 조건 이후 고정 순서로 충원
sampling.extension_trigger: exact tokenization and overlap/dedup filtering leave fewer than train512 or validation256
sampling.exhausted_status: INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_DOCUMENTS; no corpus switch or filter relaxation inside a chain
sampling.train_bank_selection: first 512 eligible unique documents by document-priority
sampling.bank_role_assignment: sort the selected train512 by bank-role; first64 S64, next128 Dev128, remaining320 Reserve320
sampling.report_selection: first256 eligible validation documents by document-priority after overlap checks against bank512; bank wins duplicate ties
sampling.public_suffix_role: domain-composition reporting only; does not alter selection

filters.language: official en split; no nonexistent row-level language_score threshold
filters.canonical_url: lower-case IDNA host, remove default port and fragment, empty path -> /; preserve scheme, path case and query
filters.dedup_normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse; comparison only, model input preserves raw text

near_duplicate.scope: selected reference documents/windows including cross-split pairs; not a corpus-wide certificate
near_duplicate.method: deterministic greedy rejection against all already selected documents; exact shingle-set Jaccard on full documents and decoded windows
near_duplicate.empty_shingle_sets: skip Jaccard when either is empty; exact normalized text checks still apply

filters.existing_wikipedia_fingerprint_scope: accessible mom2 Wikipedia assets and Wiki128 identified by hashes/counts; mom2 overlap is diagnostic, evaluator overlap is excluded
filters.evaluation_overlap: independent checker applies exact normalized text/window fingerprints and declared 13-word-shingle matches to available evaluator inputs; no answers, scores, or future subject list supplied to sampler
filters.evaluation_overlap_missing_assets: record inspected/unavailable scopes; cannot label uninspected assets overlap-free

Report256.role: policy lock 이후 독립 보고; C4 자체가 처음 보는 corpus라는 뜻은 아님

tokenization.window_decode_policy: input is the exact selected token slice, without decode/re-encode; decoded text only for overlap diagnostics
tokenization.literal_model_special_tokens_in_corpus: record tokenizer behavior and any resulting special IDs in manifest; do not silently switch tokenizer options

teacher.reference: fixed pre-edit W0, stream 전체에서 불변
teacher.storage: CPU memory-mapped shards; GPU에 document microbatch streaming
teacher.reference_packet: source/document identity, fixed input_ids and score indices, logp0[128,V], reductions and complete model/cache manifest
teacher.gradient_evaluated_at: actual native post-write preview; an identically zero KL gradient at W0 is not a failed reference set

loss.reduction: vocabulary sum -> 128 positions mean -> document mean
loss.purpose: 선정한 자연 텍스트 분포의 original response 보존; 진실성·전체 지식 보증이 아님
loss.reference_self_kl_tolerance: 기술 실측에 따라 manifest 고정; 비유한 값이나 큰 self-error를 허용하지 않음
matched_evaluation_metrics: separate requested R/P/N and active-old desired loss

experiment.route_pass_semantics: 64 documents를 microbatch별 F/B; 단일 F/B call이 아님
experiment.calibration: Freeze C4 IDs/tokens/p0 -> measure W0 N4 B1-B10 D64 -> b0=.9 max_t D64 with fixed numeric floor; never reuse a FineWeb-derived b or refresh b inside a chain
experiment.baseline_receipt_reuse: only matching W0/order/native policy/checkpoint identity; recompute new C4 metrics, never reuse old corpus KL

future_reference_extensions.name: S128
future_reference_extensions.construction: S64 plus first64 Reserve320 by frozen bank-role order; preserve Dev128 and Report256
future_reference_extensions.changes: core size only; equal doc weights1/128, fresh size-specific development ceiling
future_reference_extensions.sequence: new W0 B100x10 chain; extra64 teacher generated before run

future_reference_extensions.name: Pile robustness
future_reference_extensions.construction: new separately pinned Pile reference with same token/teacher/budget rules; do not concatenate C4 and Pile in first comparator
future_reference_extensions.changes: corpus only; source-specific N4 KL ceiling uses the same calibration recipe
future_reference_extensions.sequence: new W0 B100x10 chain after Pile text/provenance readiness; retain C4 reporting for transfer assessment

experiment.zero_write_native_history_semantics: method contract unchanged: append once per processed B100, including zero-write; accepted-label ledger separate

final768 unique IDs, roles, token windows and declared overlap audit
exact W0/tokenizer hashes and score-shift contract

artifact_contract.composition: reference-composition.json; split-wise domains/top10 share, Wikipedia/direct-mirror tags, lengths, duplicate/drop counts, overlap coverage
artifact_contract.raw_data_root: server4 local artifact root / references/C4-WebRef-v2/<manifest_sha256>; actual path recorded at build, raw text/teacher excluded from Git

selection_basis.dataset_origin: T5 / JMLR 2020; 학술지이며 conference로 표기하지 않음
selection_basis.secondary_corpus: The Pile; SmoothQuant / ICML 2023 및 AWQ / MLSys 2024

build_pipeline.action: download both complete pinned C4 source files; full sha256, bytes, gzip CRC, exact row count, source README hash
stream complete shards, form hash-priority candidate pools, preserve row/URL/timestamp/raw-text hashes, apply deterministic content filters
existing exact W0 tokenizer -> one window/document; deterministic duplicate/overlap replacement -> freeze final768 IDs, role/window hashes and composition
original FP32 W0 in eval mode -> full-vocab logp0 for S64+Dev128; streaming shards/checksums
self-KL, score shift, restoration/native parity, real post-write KL gradient finite-difference and memory/runtime smoke checks; no scientific method selection from one batch
W0 B100x10 for seven named policies; N4 calibrates source-specific b before BG-1, common requested denominator
same-data W0 SEQ1000 ablations as needed, policy lock -> Report256 teacher/evaluation on frozen endpoints; Audit/MMLU independent checks
locked method plus five baselines, W0 B100x100; preserve development/test attribution and add order replication for order claim
